data.notes: October balances industry showcases, electronic Halloween week, diaspora/world-music programming and arena-scale pop, rap and Afrobeats concerts.

events.title: Dream Nation Festival 2026 — Halloween Edition
events.venueName: Parc des Expositions Paris Nord Villepinte
events.summary: Dream Nation’s 13th edition brings two Halloween nights of electronic music to Paris Nord Villepinte, with NOVAH, Vini Vici, Pendulum DJ set, Netsky, Angerfist live, Da Tweekaz, Infected Mushroom and many more on the bill.

events.title: Céline Dion Paris 2026
events.summary: Céline Dion’s Paris 2026 limited engagement reaches its October run at Paris La Défense Arena; the 17 October performance is a confirmed representative date from the residency schedule.

events.title: MaMA Music & Convention 2026
events.summary: The 17th edition of MaMA returns to Pigalle and Montmartre for three days of music-industry convention programming and emerging-artist showcases across multiple venues.

events.title: Chevry Agency: 8th Anniversary [XXL Format · 4 Stages]
events.summary: A 22-hour, four-stage anniversary by Chevry Agency across FVTVR and Wanderlust, billed with 34+ international guests and 4,000 people expected.

events.title: Paris Electronic Week 26
events.venueName: Mains d’Œuvres / La Station - Gare des Mines / Petit Bain / Point Éphémère / TLM
events.summary: Technopol’s electronic-music convention and festival runs across Paris-area venues with conferences, workshops and live/club programming including Femme Bass Mafia, La Station live sets and Mains d’Œuvres showcases.

events.title: Festival Jazz sur Seine 2026
events.venueName: Multiple Paris and Île-de-France jazz clubs
events.summary: Paris Jazz Club’s anniversary edition spans 30 venues with 200 concerts and 450+ artists, foregrounding the city’s year-round club jazz ecosystem across jazz, blues, soul and fusion.

events.title: Asake: In God We Trust World Tour
events.summary: Nigerian Afrobeats star Asake plays Accor Arena on his In God We Trust World Tour, with BNXN and TxC listed as support.

events.title: 2026 LE SSERAFIM Tour ‘Pureflow’ in Paris
events.summary: LE SSERAFIM play their first France concert at Accor Arena as part of the 2026 ‘Pureflow’ tour.

events.title: The Strokes
events.summary: The Strokes bring an arena-scale Paris date to Accor Arena, with the venue billing the show around new album material plus the band’s catalogue classics.

events.title: TEMET x Fata Morgana
events.summary: RA Pick experimental-club takeover at La Station with Amnesia Scanner DJ set, k means b2b Simo Cell, Rosa Pistola, Rodrigue Dubois live and Fata Morgana all-stars.

events.title: AMAPIANOLAND - Amapiano & Afrobeats Halloween Day Party
events.summary: WhatsTheMotiveUK brings the touring AmapianoLand brand to Greater Paris for a 2,000-person day party centered on amapiano, afrobeats, kwaito and Afro-house culture.

events.title: Villes des Musiques du Monde 2026
events.summary: The world/diaspora music festival’s October programme includes Paris and near-Paris dates with Imarhan, Sulaf, Temenik Electric, Tiwiza, Séksion Maloya, Alune Wade and other cross-cultural projects.

events.title: ARTE Concert Festival 2026
events.summary: ARTE Concert Festival returns to La Gaîté Lyrique for two free evenings of live performances and encounters, with reported 2026 names including Shygirl and Kneecap.

events.title: Le Grand Bal — Youssou Ndour & Le Super Étoile de Dakar
events.summary: Youssou Ndour and Le Super Étoile de Dakar bring the mythic Grand Bal back to Accor Arena with guests and surprises announced for the Paris show.

events.title: Free Your Funk présente Theo Parrish All Night Long
events.summary: Detroit house figure Theo Parrish returns to Paris for a rare vinyl-only all-night set for Free Your Funk, with Matt Ma Moustache and Wolff also listed upstairs.

events.title: Spectrum Waves: Pride edition
events.summary: Large queer house/techno night by Spectrum Waves at DOCK B with two rooms, a no-photo/no-video policy and a sold-out advance allocation; RA listed 1.9K interested.

events.title: Djs for FLIRT
events.summary: RA Pick La Station night bringing together Oklou, DJ Assou, Bamao b2b Fetva, Urtrax b2b Lux18 and more for leftfield pop, bass, techno and hazy club textures.

events.title: Deepsea Grooves: Chez Damier, Mézigue, Vitaline & More
events.summary: Deepsea Grooves’ first Kilomètre25 takeover and final open-air house date of the season, led by Chicago/Detroit house figure Chez Damier with Mézigue, Vitaline, STO, Bakaer and R1D1.

events.title: Jungle
events.summary: British trio Jungle play Accor Arena on October 30, 2026, billed by the venue as their biggest French show to date. The date supports their 2026 album Sunshine.

events.title: Bigflo & Oli
events.summary: French rap duo Bigflo & Oli bring their Karma tour to Accor Arena for two confirmed nights on October 19 and 20, 2026. The venue lists both concerts at 20:00.

events.title: Grünt Festival 5
events.summary: Grünt’s hip-hop and rap festival returns to Grande Halle de la Villette with a scene-heavy lineup including Limsa D’Aulnay, Isha, BU$HI, Asfar Shamsi, REALO, DEELEE S and BEN plg.

events.title: Autechre
events.summary: Autechre perform at Le Bataclan on October 14, 2026. The Bataclan listing frames the date as part of Sean Booth and Rob Brown’s European shows in September and October 2026.

events.title: Gradur
events.summary: French trap artist Gradur plays his first Accor Arena show on October 16, 2026. The venue bills it as a landmark night in French rap history.

events.title: Meryl
events.summary: Meryl is confirmed for two Accor Arena concerts on October 26 and 27, 2026. The venue describes the run as her first show at the arena and highlights her cross-style vocal approach.

events.title: Mosimann Live
events.summary: Mosimann brings his live electronic show to Zénith Paris - La Villette on October 17 and 18, 2026. The venue positions the show as a stage-designed live performance tied to his 2026 creative cycle.

events.title: Alizée
events.summary: Alizée plays Zénith Paris - La Villette on October 4, 2026, as part of her 25th-anniversary return to the stage. The official venue page confirms the single Paris date.

events.title: Lake Street Dive
events.summary: Lake Street Dive perform at Le Bataclan on October 16, 2026. The venue describes the show around their album Good Together, mixing soul, pop, groove and jazz influences.

events.title: Bellaire — La Cigale
events.summary: French producer Bellaire brings a warm, dancefloor-focused live show to La Cigale, explicitly billed around house, electro, disco-house, jazz, funk and hip-hop influences.

events.title: Deejay MK — Afro-Caribbean Live Show
events.summary: A diaspora-focused DJ show from Ivorian/Paris-region selector Deejay MK, billed around afrobeats, dancehall, shatta, bouyon, soca, amapiano and urban club sounds at Cabaret Sauvage.

events.title: Fakear — L’Olympia
events.summary: Fakear’s new live show is described by L’Olympia as a raw, club-leaning electronic set rooted in the international bass-music resurgence.

events.title: Spectrum Waves (Nord + Sud)
events.summary: Spectrum Waves returns to La Station for a queer techno-and-house night across the Nord/Sud spaces, with a no-photo policy, awareness team, and community-first safer-space framing.
